name: Transaction Identifications 44
definition: Provides unambiguous instruction or transaction identification information.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralIn.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Collateral Instruction Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralIn.definition: Reference assigned to the instruction by the triparty-agent/service-provider.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Collateral Transaction Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.definition: Unique reference identifying the triparty-agent/service-provider collateral management transaction from the triparty-agent's/service-provider's point of view.

ClientCollateralInstructionIdentificatio.name: Client Collateral Instruction Identification
ClientCollateralInstructionIdentificatio.definition: Unique reference identifying the collateral management transaction from the client's point of view. Identifies the potential match.

ClientCollateralTransactionIdentificatio.name: Client Collateral Transaction Identification
ClientCollateralTransactionIdentificatio.definition: Unique reference identifying the collateral management transaction from the client's point of view. Present in case of a decrease.

CounterpartyCollateralInstructionIdentif.name: Counterparty Collateral Instruction Identification
CounterpartyCollateralInstructionIdentif.definition: Unique collateral instruction reference assigned by counterparty.

CounterpartyCollateralTransactionIdentif.name: Counterparty Collateral Transaction Identification
CounterpartyCollateralTransactionIdentif.definition: Unique collateral transaction reference assigned by counterparty.

CommonTransactionIdentification.name: Common Transaction Identification
CommonTransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification (UTI) agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.
